correctness.rationale: The piecewise-affine soft-threshold map realizes every DCT mask on a nonempty open cell; step decomposition gives the exact finite-mask BV norm. Independent Bernoulli masks plus the exact sine-product sum and the Rademacher fourth-moment inequality give the explicit lower bound. All finite cases n>=2 are covered; standard-library checker validates representative identities.

value.rationale: Thresholding each transform coefficient is Euclidean nonexpansive yet can amplify path variation on the scale √n. An exact finite-n operator formula and proved universal growth rate identify a substantive stability limitation for a classical nonlinear spectral denoiser; unlike arbitrary parameter slices, the invariant measures worst-case edge creation on the natural ordered signal graph.
